steps.name: activateAmpUnits
steps.summary: Activate all AMP Units leading to the Bio Lab power node

steps.name: raisePackAPunchElevator
steps.summary: Raise the Pack‑a‑Punch elevator from underwater

steps.name: grabHardDrive
steps.summary: Shoot the activated tentacle trap with the Beamsmasher to drop the Hard Drive and return it to the Security Station

steps.name: freeNathan
steps.summary: Enter the three‑digit code at the Bio Lab pod to free Nathan
notes: First digit: hour hand on the clock in the Interrogation Room
Second digit: playing card rank in the Mess Hall (Ace = 1)
Third digit: "Days Since Last Incident" on the Engineering sign

steps.name: amalgamNathan
steps.summary: Defeat the Amalgam Nathan and pick up the dropped keycard

steps.name: reEstablishComms
steps.summary: Repair two Node Connectors to re-establish communications
notes: Each repair spawns Parasites and triggers a defense round

steps.name: hackBuoys
steps.summary: Hack all three satellite buoys within 2 minutes using the Hacking Device

steps.name: disarmNukes
steps.summary: Disarm the three nuclear devices in the Bio Lab under a 5-minute timer

steps.name: defeatPatient13
steps.summary: Defeat Owen Guthrie (Patient 13) through all three phases
notes: Phase 1: damage tentacle bulbs, clear zombies → Max Ammo
Phase 2: target glowing maw, clear stronger zombies → Max Ammo
Phase 3: dodge electrical orb, tentacle grab, and slam attacks
